items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Snow worked with me... I had a fellow called Snow Fisher. Well, we worked all the summer.

ctx.x: Bricktop worked there, but later Snow worked with me. But Bricktop was the ruling singer. And they had a man there called Tony Donovan. Well, Tony was good because -- but Bricktop was the queen of the thing. Because Bricktop couldn't sing anything either. But she was a very fine hostess.
